description:
List your apps

Every app the developer owns, whatever its status (draft, in review, published, suspended, removed), newest change first, each with its latest build's submission state and how many violations are open. Each `id` is the app's id in every other developer app operation. `wallet` is required and must be the signed-in wallet. The public Apps directory is not part of this list.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).

wallet.description: Your EVM wallet address (`0x` + 40 hex). Must be the signed-in wallet; any other wallet is refused with 403. It selects nothing: the route only ever reads the caller's own data.

name: list_developer_apps
title: List my apps
